codex.label: Codex CLI
codex.hint: Install the OpenAI Codex CLI to dispatch packets.

claude-code.label: Claude Code
claude-code.hint: Install Anthropic's Claude Code CLI to dispatch packets.

gemini.label: Gemini CLI
gemini.hint: Gemini CLI remains available for enterprise and paid API access. For free or AI Pro/Ultra use Antigravity CLI.

antigravity.label: Antigravity CLI
antigravity.hint: Install Google Antigravity CLI (agy) for free or AI Pro/Ultra agent sessions.

opencode.label: OpenCode 2 CLI
opencode.hint: Install OpenCode 2 to use its multi-provider worker and shared service.

3code.label: 3code CLI
3code.hint: Install 3code, then run it once to configure a model provider.

magnitude.label: Magnitude CLI
magnitude.hint: On macOS or Linux, install Magnitude, then launch it in a visible repository terminal to choose a local model or custom endpoint.

cursor.label: Cursor CLI
cursor.hint: Install Cursor CLI to dispatch packets through Cursor.

grok.label: Grok Build
grok.hint: Install Grok Build and set GROK_CODE_XAI_API_KEY to dispatch packets.

pi.label: Pi
pi.hint: Install Pi and bring your Anthropic or OpenAI API key.

ollama.label: Ollama
ollama.hint: Install Ollama to run local models for embeddings + offline workflows.
